question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

PARDON : NODRAP :: DELIGHT : THGILED :: EVERYTHING : ?
solution:
The pattern followed in the given codes is:

 **The alphabets are arranged in backwards order to form the code.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b05ab6f5be94b472e92a40bb46f3e4af738d12286a9af5aacbabfa95ce690db.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53ffc723261f52a281ab79136ecb896fbd719f7d7cc96bdf91949c28720d204f.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d5d36d6d6328e2e40509fbf2a7ba96ac1aac2b0ed23a252cfb91d4378e18a6c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**option (2)".**
